name: distributed-systems
description: Deterministic teaching primitives for durable fan-out work: transactional outbox, retained logs and consumer positions, expansion, worker dispatch, external effects, downstream receipts, retries, completed-job dedupe, and admission backpressure. Reusable for webhooks, asynchronous job delivery, and notification pipelines.
limits: This is a bounded staged fan-out pipeline, not an arbitrary graph execution engine. system_dag is a separate visualization object.
Ticks are scheduler intervals, not elapsed seconds. No network calls, randomness, partitions, checkpoint recovery, broker transactions, lease crashes, or persistence across browser reloads.
A successful external effect and an acknowledged ledger completion do not prove downstream receipt. Lost acknowledgments may duplicate effects. Finite retries can terminate without delivery.

Directory resolution uses a static snapshot, runs synchronously within fan-out, and does not model lookup latency, pagination, relationship updates, authentication, or device addresses. Admission preflights the same snapshot for exact capacity reservation.

arguments.common: model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy
arguments.model: Structured configuration object assembled by dsModel from separate scene tables. No serialized JSON input or model cell.
arguments.frame: 0..240; recomputes deterministic state from the beginning.
arguments.targets: 1..40. Without a directory, generated targets per request. With source/target directories and memberships, query limit on unique known targets subscribed to the selected source.
arguments.workers: 1..12 concurrent in-flight slots. Long response delays hold slots across ticks.
arguments.effectRate: 1..12 attempts per tick; dispatch is paced at min(available worker slots,effectRate).
arguments.failure: 0 healthy; 1 temporary external-service outage; 2 one lost acknowledgment on request 1 / target 1 / attempt 1; 3 permanent target-1 failure; 4 outage from outageStart through the remainder of the run.
arguments.dedupe: 0 disable or 1 enable pre-dispatch lookup of acknowledged completed jobs.
arguments.capacity: 1..120 outstanding obligations; enforced only when admissionBound is true, before commit. Counts outbox, staging, deferred, queue, in-flight, and retry obligations.
arguments.policy: 0 abandon transient/ambiguous attempts; 1 retry up to maxAttempts with backoffBase^attempt tick delays.

model.submissions: [{tick,count}], default one request at tick 1. Up to 120 requests total; ticks 1..240, count 1..12.
model.deferredFraction: 0..1 (default 0). floor(targets*fraction) jobs per request wait for the deferred trigger.
model.resumeTick: 1..240, default 12. A single trigger releases jobs already deferred at this tick; jobs deferred later remain pending.
model.replays: [{tick,request,target}], default []. Appends another delivery record for an already committed request. Requests not yet committed and targets outside the selected fan-out are skipped.
model.receiptExcluded: Target numbers with no downstream receipt; default []. External acceptance and acknowledged completion still occur.
model.requestPrefix: Identity prefix, default r. 1..24 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
model.targetPrefix: Identity prefix, default t. Same constraints.
model.outageEnd: 1..240, default 10; inclusive end of temporary outage.
model.sources: Optional source identity directory, 1..40 unique identifiers. A source need not be a user.
model.targets: Optional target identity directory, 1..40 unique identifiers.
model.memberships: Optional [{source,target}] subscription relations; endpoints must exist in directories. Up to 1600 rows; duplicates removed during lookup.
model.source: Selected source identity; defaults to first source. The directory fields must be supplied together.

stores.effects: Append-only external acceptance history, including repeated effects
stores.followers: Unique follower identities for selected source
stores.intents: Committed intent identities with source provenance

dsCount.signature: dsCount(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy, store)
dsCount.description: Exact entry count in a store.

dsCell.signature: dsCell(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy, store, idx)
dsCell.description: Identity at idx (0-based). Render min(dsCount(...),8) cells; when more than 8 entries exist, cell 7 summarizes the remainder.

dsMetric.signature: dsMetric(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy, metric)
dsMetric.description: Metrics: accepted, effectAccepted, receiptCount (distinct targets), duplicates, rejected, expired, terminal, retries, attempts, writes (two commit rows plus expanded jobs), queued, backlog, sourceConsumed, deliveryConsumed, relayed.

dsFlow.signature: dsFlow(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy, edge)
dsFlow.description: Current-tick transition counts: commit, relay, fanout, claim, accept, receipt, retry, resume, read (deferred trigger), terminal, dedupe, ack, dead.

dsAction.signature: dsAction(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy)

dsExplain.signature: dsExplain(model, frame, targets, workers, effectRate, failure, dedupe, capacity, policy)
dsExplain.description: Markdown narration derived from transitions and current scheduling state.

dsModel.signature: dsModel(settings, submissions, sources, targets, memberships, replays, receiptExclusions, sourceIndex)
dsModel.description: Accepts ordinary arrays of row objects from dataTable(tableName), validates them, selects a 1-based source, and assembles a structured configuration without mutating table rows.

tables.settings: One row of scalar simulator options such as deferredFraction, resumeTick, maxAttempts and requestPrefix.
tables.submissions: Rows {tick,count}; each row schedules an incoming batch.
tables.memberships: Rows {source,target}; subscriptions joining the identity directories.
tables.receiptExclusions: Rows {target}; target ordinals with no modeled downstream receipt.
